resources.string: Status bar appearance diagnostics and manual refresh
Unable to read. Check that the module is active in the system framework scope.
The launcher requested dark icons over a dark wallpaper region. Return Home to verify.
No live launcher wallpaper subscription was found. This may affect wallpaper updates.
Configuration snapshot captured. Return Home to check the actual appearance.
Wallpaper regions come from the wallpaper service. The launcher request is its last window state, not the foreground of this page or a screen measurement. Read again after returning Home if needed.

Briefly refreshes system appearance, then restores the mode service’s current configuration. Your selected mode, automatic schedule and theme are preserved. Return Home afterward to check readability.
Configuration refreshed and restored; please verify on Home.
This system does not expose a safely restorable refresh interface.
Refresh did not complete; configuration restoration was attempted.
Configuration restoration could not be confirmed. Check system appearance settings.
Last refresh was not confirmed complete. Read the status again.
